This petition under 439 of Cr.PC is filed by the accused No.3 to enlarge him on bail in Crime No.14/2023 pending on the file of the IV Addl. Civil Judge and JMFC Court, Vijayapura for the offences punishable under Sections 363, 376-D(L), 323, 504, 506 read with Section 34 of IPC.

2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner - accused No.3 and the learned High Court Government Pleader for the respondent - State.
3.

The summary of the charge sheet is that, three accused came near the bus stand where the victim was waiting to alight the bus proceeding to Hirebegur, and informed the victim that, there was no bus available at this time and the bus to the destination will be available at new bus stand, and offered her to drop to the new bus stand.

Thereafter, they took her to the bazar and offered water,
and forced her to remove her cloths and when she resisted, they assaulted her and committed forcible sexual intercourse.

Initially, the FIR was lodged against the unknown person and when she was sent for medical examination, she has stated as follows:
"History as per her own statement: She narrated history bit by bit, she had been to Sanjeevinipaara medical college to meet her friends, from there she was returning by walk when she came near Ibrahimpur gate some one talk t her and took her on h is bike for some distance started misbehaving with her

, she resisted, after threatening he left her on road, she took some rest near Laxminagar, then started walking and reached satellite bus station at NC: 2023:KHC-K:5610 11 pm some people came one among them Mr.Imran on enquiry who forced and raped her with support of others,
later at 8 AM some people of Umesh Vandal cited her at satellite bus stand and took her to hospital."
4. The FIR was lodged against the unknown person and in the statement before the Medical Officer,
she has stated that one Imran has raped her.
The FSL report produced along with the charge sheet indicates that seminal stain was not detected and spermatozoa were not detected.
The police during the course of investigation have apprehended the accused No.3 along with other accused and filed the charge sheet.
However, Imran, who is said to have committed rape on the victim has not been charge sheeted.
Except the confession statement, the police have not produced any material along with the charge sheet for implicating the accused herein.

It is settled law that the accused cannot be convicted on the basis of the confession statement as specified under Section 25 of the Evidence Act Umar Farooque vs The State Of Karnataka on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/176404292/
2 in the absence of any corroborative material.

sentences.text: The petitioner - accused No.3 has made out a prima facie case to enlarge him on bail.

Accordingly, I pass the following:
ORDER i) Criminal petition is allowed.
ii) Petitioner-accused No.3 is enlarged on bail in CC No.703/2023 arising out of Crime No.14/2023 registered by the Vijayapur Women Police Station, pending on the file of the learned IV Addl. Civil Judge & JMFC Court, Vijayapura for the offences punishable under Sections 363, 376-(D)(L), 323, 504, NC: 2023:KHC-K:5610 506 read with Section 34 of IPC, subject to the following conditions:
(a) The petitioner/accused No.3 shall furnish a personal bond for a sum of Rs.1 lakh with one surety for the like sum to the satisfaction of the jurisdictional Court.
(b) He shall appear before the Court as and when required.
(c) He shall not threaten or allure the prosecution witnesses in whatsoever manner.
(d) He shall not get involved in similar offences.
(e) He shall not leave the territorial limits of the Trial Court without prior permission of the Trial Court.
